name: Continental Cable LLC
old_description: Continental Cable is a leading manufacturer of custom steel cable, wire rope, wire rope cable assemblies, cable hardware, and fittings.
about:
Continental Cable LLC was founded in 1969 in Hinsdale, New Hampshire. The company operates as a manufacturer of custom steel cable, wire rope, and related assemblies, serving industrial and commercial markets.

The company produces custom steel cable, wire rope, wire rope cable assemblies, cable hardware, fittings, and plastic-coated cable. Its integrated capabilities include swaging, stranding, extrusion, and machining. The facility employs 65 people.

Continental Cable serves aerospace, military, automotive, agriculture, fire safety, exercise/fitness, marine, medical, telecommunications, and outdoor recreation industries. It is a qualified producer for MIL-DTL-83420 and supplies military and federal agencies.

The company emphasizes its integrated manufacturing capabilities, adherence to strict commercial and government standards, and certifications to AS9100 and ISO 9001. It highlights fast turnaround, competitive pricing, and seasoned industry expertise.
